◆ Fashion Guide of the Cosmos: Dream Promenade Event Details ◆
● During the Fashion Guide of the Cosmos: Dream Promenade event, there will be a limited-time discount for Evanescia's outfit, Lunar Blossoming.
● Spend Stellar Jade ×<unbreak>2,680</unbreak> to claim the outfit, which comes with a gift of its corresponding avatar.
● After the event has concluded, the outfit Lunar Blossoming will be available for purchase in the Outfit Show Window and revert to the original price of Stellar Jade ×<unbreak>3,280</unbreak>.
● Each outfit is limited to 1 per account and cannot be acquired repeatedly.

◆ Lunar Blossoming Outfit Details ◆
● After purchasing the Lunar Blossoming Outfit, it can be viewed at the "Character — Outfit" interface.
● After changing into Lunar Blossoming, Evanescia will be equipped with the corresponding Outfit during exploration and Combat.
● Changing the Outfit will not affect Evanescia's appearance during story scenes.
